# InBharat AI

> InBharat.ai builds local-first private AI for people and organisations.
> Flagship product direction: UnoOne Power (desktop) and UnoOne Mobile (Android).
> Enterprise systems: JAK Swarm and JAK Shield. Research: SILT.

Current product capabilities depend on tested builds and pilot access. The earlier Pocket AI pen-drive product has been discontinued. Patent filings are historical research, not proof of production readiness.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.inbharat.ai/): private AI ecosystem overview.
- [UnoOne](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone): private personal AI.
- [UnoOne Power](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone/power): desktop private AI.
- [UnoOne Mobile](https://www.inbharat.ai/unoone/mobile): Android agent.
- [Enterprise AI](https://www.inbharat.ai/enterprise-ai): controlled agent workflows.
- [Technology](https://www.inbharat.ai/technology): SILT and local-first AI.
- [About](https://www.inbharat.ai/about): company details.
- [Contact](https://www.inbharat.ai/contact): pilots and partnerships.
- [Learn AI](https://www.inbharat.ai/learn-ai-with-reeturaj): practical AI articles.
- [InBharat Console](https://www.inbharat.ai/app): web-based AI console.
- [JAK Swarm](https://jakswarm.com): enterprise agent workflows.
- [KathaKitaab](https://www.kathakitaab.com): interactive stories.
- [TestsPrep](https://testsprep.in): AI-supported learning.
